title: AI credit
teacherSubtitle: See your balance, request more credit, and check the tokens and cost of every AI request.
adminSubtitle: Read teacher usage and manage the school's reserve. The platform owner adds new credit.
amountHelp: USD, from $0.01 to $1,000. Use up to two decimal places, for example 5.50.

stateHelp.ok: AI features are on. After use, you get an email when your balance is at or below {{threshold}}, and another if it runs out.
stateHelp.low: Your balance is at or below {{threshold}}. Request more credit to keep using AI.
stateHelp.empty: AI features are off until your school admin allocates more credit. Everything that does not use AI keeps working.
stateHelp.paused: Your school admin has paused your credit. Ask them to turn it back on to use AI.

request.title: Ask for more credit
request.body: Your school admin sees this request on their AI credit page and decides how much to allocate from the school reserve.
request.notePlaceholder: For example: the AI tools for two classes this week
request.invalid: Enter an amount between $0.01 and $1,000, with up to two decimal places.
request.pendingBody: You asked for {{amount}} on {{date}}. Your school admin has not answered yet.

history.title: Usage history
history.subtitle: Every AI request with its tokens and cost in US cents (¢), plus credit added or removed. An unusable reply is still charged because its tokens were used.

admin.title: AI credit dashboard
admin.waitingBody: Approving moves the amount from the school reserve to the teacher. If the reserve is short, ask the platform owner for a top-up first.
admin.decisionNotePlaceholder: For example: approved for this term
admin.teachersBody: All accounts start with no credit. Open an account to add credit, change its warning level, or pause AI use.
admin.noTeachers: No eligible accounts in this school yet.

dialog.invalid: Enter an amount between $0.01 and $1,000, with up to two decimal places.
dialog.warningHelp: Enter $0–$1,000, up to two decimal places. After AI use, the account holder gets an email at this level and another when credit runs out. Adding credit above the level resets its alert.
dialog.pauseHelp: New AI requests are blocked while paused. Requests already running may still finish and be charged.
dialog.settingsInvalid: Enter a warning level between $0 and $1,000, with up to two decimal places.
dialog.allocateHelp: The amount moves from the school reserve into this account. You cannot allocate more than the reserve holds.
dialog.reclaimHelp: Only unspent credit the school allocated can go back. Spent credit stays spent.

topUp.title: Ask the platform for school credit
topUp.body: Only the platform owner can add new credit to the school. They see this request on their AI credit console.
topUp.notePlaceholder: For example: enough for the second term
topUp.help: When approved, the amount is split equally across active staff and the rest is kept as the reserve.
topUp.sent: Request sent to the platform owner.
topUp.pendingBody: You asked the platform for {{amount}} on {{date}}. It has not been answered yet.

errors.required: You have no AI credit left. Ask your school admin for more on the AI credit page.
errors.paused: Your admin has paused your AI credit. Ask them to turn it back on.
errors.pricing: AI pricing is not configured for this model. Ask the system administrator to set verified input, cached-input and output rates before using AI.
